title: Classroom Life & Montessori
description: Authentic snapshots of experiential learning, Montessori sensorial discovery, and joyful circle time routines at Kaylan.

items.caption: Morning Circle Time - Interactive storytelling, rhymes and joyful group learning under the rainbow mural.
Montessori Sensorial Discovery - Exploring the human anatomy puzzle, geometric solids and color sorting cylinders.
Concentrated Hands-on Learning - Working with tactile sensory blocks, sandpaper materials and transport cards.
Early Sensory Exploration - Developing fine tactile discrimination and color recognition with wooden apparatus.
Phonics & Vocabulary Building - Word cards, picture matching and interactive language activities.
Montessori Sensorial Lab - Low accessible wooden shelving lined with authentic didactic materials.
Montessori Didactic Apparatus - Cylinder blocks, binomial cube cabinets and botanical leaf trays.
Bright Nursery Classroom - Ergonomic peacock chairs, collaborative study tables and star recognition board.
Action Rhyme Time - Teacher-led movement, song gestures and joyful toddler expression.

title: Campus & Play Spaces
description: Safe, child-friendly 2-story campus with outdoor entrance ramp, bright learning rooms and indoor activity turf.

items.caption: Campus Front Elevation - Vibrant rainbow stripes, Buddha mosaic mural and child-safe gated entrance.
Welcoming Entrance Ramp - Barrier-free accessibility, marigold garlands and colorful balloons.
Full Campus Perspective - Independent preschool building nestled in Electronic City Phase 1.
Indoor Activity Turf - Soft green lawn area for morning assemblies, yoga and safe indoor play.
Interactive Learning Hall - Smart screen audiovisual setup surrounded by Montessori sensorial units.
Reading & Toy Loft - Curated storybooks, wooden transport toys and planetary solar system models.
Audiovisual & Math Zone - Dedicated screen corner and tactile abacus calculation apparatus.

title: Art, Craft & Discovery
description: Tactile creativity, pastel coloring, fine motor development, and artistic expression at child-height tables.

items.caption: Focused Crayon Art - Developing fine-motor tripod grasp and mindful color concentration.
Creative Coloring Studio - Vibrant workbook activities and shape recognition exercises.
Teacher-Guided Art Class - Warm, individualized teacher guidance nurturing toddler self-confidence.
Collaborative Drawing Tables - Sharing pastel crayons and creating artwork alongside friends.
Shape Sorting & Time Dial - Exploring geometry, counting frames and tactile spatial puzzles.

title: Festivals & Celebrations
description: Celebrating diversity, Indian cultural traditions, music, dance and friendship together as one Kaylan family.

items.caption: Festive Celebration Gathering - Children and teachers posing happily in colorful traditional dress.
Dussehra Festive Art - Handcrafted 10-headed Ravana creative installation adorned with marigold flowers.
Rhythmic Celebration Dance - Joyful music and festive movement on the green indoor court.
Expressive Dance Poses - Children performing cultural folk dance steps with radiant smiles.
Joyful Toddler Laughter - Cheerful moments and festive friendships during campus celebrations.
High Energy & Celebratory Poses - Toddlers dancing with excitement in beautiful attire.
Traditional Attire Parade - Posing in lehengas, pavadas and traditional Indian outfits.
Fun Group Dice Games - Interactive turn-taking and playful social interaction on the turf.
